# ScaleUp Developments

> ScaleUp is a Frisco, Texas developer that builds, leases, and operates small-bay
> flex, warehouse, and showroom space in North Texas. Current developments:
> Rockwall Flex Park (4156 N Goliad St, Rockwall, TX — 30 units of 1,500/2,000/3,000 SF,
> under construction, delivering Summer 2027, leasing now) and McKinney Flex Park
> (1990 N McDonald St, McKinney, TX 75071 — mixed-use retail/showroom/flex,
> ~75,000 SF, breaking ground Q4 2026).

Key facts:
- Unit sizes: 1,500, 2,000, and 3,000 SF small-bay flex units
- Features: grade-level 12x12 doors, individual HVAC, 3-phase power, 18' clear height, LED lighting
- Leases: NNN (triple net); leasing inquiries: contactus@scaleupflex.com, (469) 628-1922
- Principals: Murtuza Tinwala (industrial & operations), Huzefa Tinwala (construction & design), Khalid Motorwala (capital & finance)
